Watts printed the hymn under John 6:31, 35, 39. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

31Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, as it is written: ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’” 35Jesus answered, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger, and whoever believes in Me will never thirst. 39And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that I shall lose none of those He has given Me, but raise them up at the last day. JOHN 6:31, 35, 39 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ JOHN 6
Let us adore th' eternal Word, 'Tis he our souls hath fed; Thou art our living stream, O Lord, And thou th' immortal bread. STANZA I
